title: Don’t bother
text:

features: ✅【4 IN 1 KNIFE SHARPENER:】 Our knife sharpeners come with 4 slots that can sharpen all types of blades. The lightning slot is for Scissors Grinding. Slot CRUDE is a diamond sharpening rod for repairs and straightens damaged blades. Slot FINE is a tungsten steel blade sharpens to restore the knife's V-shape. Slot ESSENCE is a ceramic blade stage for polish and eliminates burrs on the metal blade.

✅【EASY TO USE: 】Press down with the strength of the daily sharpening knife, and pull it backward. Do not push or pull back and forth. TIPS: In order to get the best effect out of this knife sharpener, sharpen your knife with one direction only. Grinding scissors require you to find a suitable angle to avoid damage to the scissors.

✅【CONVENIENT AND DURABLE: 】Piroir Knife sharpener is big enough to be handled properly and small enough to fit into any kitchen drawer.
